name: durable-spec-prose-reconcile-0-17
body:
Reconciliation 0.17 — durable-spec prose aligned to the shipped v0.17.0 structural scanner and tier-separable harness [autonomous]. Four stale-prose items were each verified against the branch graph before editing.

(1) `solution.component.structural-scanner-crate` (updated in place): the body no longer asserts `rust.mdfrontend` as current code. Evidence: `MATCH (n) WHERE n.fqn STARTS WITH 'rust.mdfrontend'` returns 0 nodes — the mdlib Markdown frontend is retired, and the `md` stream id is served today by `structlib` (`rust.structfrontend.md`). The component contract (self-contained, no scan-time toolchain, no external runtime, no engine pin beyond its crates) is unchanged; the absorption is now stated as historical.

(2) `global.constraint.test-tier-boundaries` (updated in place, two clauses): the pinned alias is corrected to the real `.cargo/config.toml` value `test-e2e = "test e2e:: -- --ignored --test-threads=4"`, with the thread bound recorded as required, not cosmetic — lbug reserves ~8 TiB of virtual address space per `Database` and the heavy e2e crates (e.g. `splice_e2e`) exhaust the process address space at libtest's default parallelism (`Buffer manager exception: Mmap for size 8796093022208 failed`). The helper clause is restated: non-test helpers/fixtures/builders live on the shared public library harness `apg::testutil` (`src/testutil.rs`; `pub mod testutil;` at `src/lib.rs:30`, unconditional) or the crate's `tests/common/mod.rs`, never inside a tier submodule and never stranded in a production module's inline `mod tests`.

(3) `global.note.test-e2e-alias-consequence` (historical note corrected): the feedback-3 narrative is preserved verbatim; only the closing "Plan consequence" sentence is corrected, because `.cargo/config.toml` is now a graphed `File` node (`code_type = 'config'`), so its edit is scheduled by FQN rather than as ungraphed config work. A status line notes the alias has since gained `--test-threads=4`, now pinned in `global.constraint.test-tier-boundaries`.

(4) "no `File` node" claims elsewhere — corrected in three notes that asserted the present state: `requirements.note.decomposition-reframe-reconciliation`, `global.note.agents-md-test-laws-drift` and `solution.note.library-surface-non-graph-artifacts`. All three claimed `Cargo.toml` / `.cargo/config.toml` / `scripts/gate.sh` / `apg/config.json` / `rust-toolchain.toml` had no `File` node; the structural scanner graphs all of them (`code_type = 'config'`), so their edits can be scheduled by FQN. `requirements.note.graph-visible-tests-config-premise` needed no edit: it already carries the feedback-8 graph-status correction marking the original premise false.

Reported, not edited (out of the four-item scope): `solution.note.md-frontend-retirement` still calls `rust.mdfrontend` and its emitters "the real anchors" in the present tense — the same retirement as item (1), flagged for a decision.

Evidence basis: `MATCH (f:File) WHERE f.fqn IN ['.cargo/config.toml','Cargo.toml','scripts/gate.sh','apg/config.json','install.sh','LICENSE']` returns all six with `code_type = 'config'`; `.cargo/config.toml:30` carries the `--test-threads=4` bound; `src/lib.rs:30` declares `pub mod testutil;` unconditionally; `MATCH (n) WHERE n.fqn STARTS WITH 'rust.mdfrontend'` returns 0 nodes while `rust.structfrontend.md` resolves.
